labels.note: HER2-altered advanced solid tumor basket; he has an untreated intracranial-only glioma.

evidence.quote: Have histologically confirmed Grade 3 IDH-mutant oligodendroglioma according to WHO 2021 criteria per local assessment.

labels.note: Oligodendroglioma cohort is grade 3 only; other cohorts need recurrent glioma or astrocytoma. His is a newly diagnosed grade 2 oligodendroglioma.
